intended_object: A continuous k-linear equivalence between `ULift C(G, M)` and `C(ULift G, ULift M)`. The docstring and the module name (`HomogeneousCochainsUlift`) show it is universe-lifting plumbing for moving homogeneous cochains between universe levels.
explanation: This is not a mathematical object but a Lean-level device. `ULift` changes only the universe level of a type, not its mathematics. Mathematically, the equivalence is the identity of C(G, M). The construction is built from `ULift.up` and `ULift.down`, and continuity of each direction follows from pre- and post-composition with continuous maps. It is the kind of internal glue a library needs to transport its cochain complexes across universes. It has no counterpart in the literature, so faithfulness and generality do not apply to it.
